$comment: The structure of a Perturb-seq data file, format 0, as data. Both validators read this file. SPEC.md section 2 states the rules; rules that need computing (order of cells within a feature, uniqueness, the same cells in every modality) are code in each language.

descriptions.file: one dataset, written once and never modified
descriptions.modality: one kind of measurement on the cells
descriptions.counts: raw counts, cells × features, stored by feature
descriptions.cell_table: one row per cell: measurements of this modality
descriptions.grna_table: one row per gRNA: what it targets
descriptions.shared_cell_table: one row per cell: facts about the cell, whatever was measured
descriptions.metadata: what the file says about itself: the format version, which dataset this is, and what kind of screen it was

index.$comment: The one type of both index arrays (S4.2, S4.3). It is `narrow` while the largest of the number of stored values, the number of cells and the number of features is at most `narrow_up_to`, and `wide` beyond. This is the type scipy chooses for a sparse matrix of that size.

storage_kinds.int32: an `array` of 32-bit signed integers, with no missing value

every_modality.name: n_nonzero
every_modality.description: the cell's number of features with a nonzero count

every_modality.name: p_mito
every_modality.description: the cell's fraction of mitochondrial counts

grna_table.name: grna_target
grna_table.description: what the gRNA is aimed at; `non-targeting` for a negative control

grna_table.name: target_end
grna_table.description: last base of the target, included

grna_table.name: vector_id
grna_table.description: the vector that delivers the gRNA

perturb_seq_format.description: the version of the Perturb-seq data file format this file follows

dataset_id.description: identifies the dataset; random, assigned at import

source.description: where the data came from: a URL, DOI or accession

organism.description: the organism, as a scientific name

genome_build.description: the genome build of the positions; required when the gRNA table has positions
